svg.title: Which guide page you need when
svg.desc: A timeline through the thesis or dissertation, with the guide page for each stage. 1, Decide: How it works 2, Set up: Get started, and Bring your draft if you have one. 3, Write: Writing basics and Citations. 4, Share drafts with your advisor: Going further. 5, Preliminary formatting review, before you defend: Submitting and Check your PDF. 6, Defend: Reviewer checklist, for your committee. 7, Submit: Submitting. A band under the whole timeline, labelled any time you're stuck, holds two pages that help at every stage: Fixing problems and How do I…?
svg.text: which guide page you need, and when
any time you're stuck, at every stage
